title: Culture House DC

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: With 15,000+ square feet of artful space in Southwest Washington, DC, Culture House is a venue unlike any other in the District. From celebratory gatherings to private parties and conferences to live music and immersive performances, Culture House has room for it all. Set against the backdrop of Culture House’s vibrant exterior, the Courtyard is a flexible, open-air event space. Well-suited for everything from displaying works of art to hosting a special occasion, the Lounge is primed for any party. Housed on Culture House’s 2nd floor with a recently renovated stage and new dance floor, the Performance + Event Space is perfect for entertaining up to 200
